about: GET /v1/connect/apps?provider=p&cursor=…: the provider's next page, its last. Written by tafs cloud's tests (runtime/test/contract.ts); write it again with UPDATE_CONTRACTS=1, never by hand.

words.title: Cloud browser
words.line: Works while your computer is off.
facts: A fresh browser for each run, only on the sites you allow.
You sign in once, in a live view. Your password is never kept.

words.title: Chrome extension
words.line: Works in your Chrome, where you're signed in.
facts: Uses the sign-ins already in your Chrome. Your passwords stay there.
Banks and password managers stay blocked unless your phone allows each one.
